# Harrison

[Island](../codex/places.md#island)

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

- **Family:** [Emily](../character/emily.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with a round face and prominent blue eyes. His appearance is also described as neat and snug.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

A crusty, crabbed, and lonesome old pipe-smoker, Mr. Harrison prides himself on his outspokenness and harbors a strong prejudice against marriage. Despite his difficult demeanor and distaste for being pitied, he displays an outwardly sympathetic nature, acts kindly, and regularly attends church. Pragmatic in business dealings, he puts on a white collar when negotiating so that looking prosperous will prevent others from trying to cheat him.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P78](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0078), +2 more_

## History

Before moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Harrison was an old bachelor who lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). Shortly after settling in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he furiously confronted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) over her cow trespassing in his oat field, though he later accepted her written confession and cow in good-natured exchange when she accidentally sold his Jersey cow. Over time, Harrison became a friendly neighbor who shared tea and candid opinions with [Anne](../character/anne.md), though he refused to donate money to her Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). He endured local misfortunes alongside his neighbors, including a devastating hailstorm that killed his parrot. Eventually, Harrison revealed to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he was actually married, explaining that he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) had previously separated over his housecleaning habits and his parrot, before the two reconciled and [Emily](../character/emily.md) rejoined him in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P24](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0024), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), +345 more_

> “Who? Mrs. Lynde? Don’t you tell me I’m like that old gossip,” said Mr. Harrison irritably. “I’m not . . . not a bit. What have you got in that box?”

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--harrison.md)

Harrison's relationship with [Anne](../character/anne.md) begins on tense terms when he furiously confronts her over a stray cow eating his oats, leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to insult his baldness. Their dynamic changes after [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly sells Harrison's cow and brings a cake to apologize, which Harrison takes good-naturedly. The two quickly become close friends who enjoy visiting each other in the evenings for tea and pleasant conversation, despite Harrison occasionally frustrating [Anne](../character/anne.md) by refusing to donate to her town improvement projects.

- Friend of — good friends who visit and chat in the evening  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

After a rocky introduction involving a mistaken transaction over a cow, Harrison and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) become friendly neighbors who enjoy spending time together over tea and cake. [Anne](../character/anne.md) often visits Harrison on his porch to chat about local affairs and her personal life. Although Harrison holds doubts about Anne's educational philosophy of teaching without corporal punishment, the two maintain a warm, conversational friendship.

- Friend of — neighbors who became friends over tea and cake  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P31](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0031)</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is Harrison's wife. The couple was previously separated due to conflicts over housecleaning habits and Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). After sharing the story of their past fallout with [Anne](../character/anne.md), Harrison reconciles with [Emily](../character/emily.md), who returns home and warmly receives [Anne](../character/anne.md).

- Spouse of — married  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), +1 more</sub>
